statement: NVIDIA is the exclusive AI compute infrastructure provider for the campus, where OpenAI is the customer under a 20-year lease and the guarantee only pays out if OpenAI defaults or becomes insolvent.
why: Exclusivity locks a very large future compute site to one accelerator vendor, while tying the vendor's payout risk to a single customer's creditworthiness concentrates both the demand and the exposure.

impact.mechanism: Exclusive-provider status forecloses competing accelerators at this site while making the vendor's realized demand and guarantee exposure dependent on one frontier lab customer.

evidence.excerpt: SB Energy will build, own and operate the data center; OpenAI is the customer under a 20-year lease; NVIDIA is the exclusive AI compute infrastructure provider and provides credit support on the land, power and shell buildout.

confidence.basis: Structure described in NVIDIA's own press release filed as an exhibit to Form 8-K.
